post.title: Firecrawl wants $19 a month to read the web. FATSEARCH doesn't.
post.caption: Two fresh grudges: web reading for AI agents without Firecrawl's monthly bill, and a spending tracker that never asks for your bank login.

segments.quote: Tools like Firecrawl or Tavily get expensive fast

cues.say: Firecrawl wants nineteen dollars a month

cues.cap: to read a web page for your agent.

segments.quote: I got tired of modern budgeting apps charging $10–$15/month subscriptions just to tell me what I already know
